summary: refactor(shared): move fxa-shared subscriptions to a legacy lib
description:
Because:

* fxa-shared subscriptions and dto/auth/payments code belongs in an nx lib.

This commit:

* Moves the 13 files to libs/accounts/subscriptions-legacy.
* Leaves one-line re-export shims in fxa-shared, with a shim spec.
* Repoints 34 auth-server and admin-server importers to the new alias.
* Adds the alias to the tsconfig and jest configs.
* Adds accept-language-parser to the root package.json.

Closes FXA-10672
